title: A building's fire: face, rubble, going out, gone
oneLine: A hit building's fire through face, rubble and out modes, split across a fires Map and a going list.
topConcern: Self-timeout and heap-gone exits leave an 'out' fire in the Map, swallowing new hits on that building for up to 4.2 s.

title: A figure on fire (PersonFire): lit, dying down, hidden, kept
oneLine: The building's flames on a burning figure: made once, lit, dying down, hidden and reused; peers released when done.

title: A campfire on screen: light catching, adopted, burning down, dying, gone
oneLine: One campfire Fire through light, adoption by its campfire record, fuse burn-down and dying, fed by four record sources.
topConcern: A peer's light is adopted only if campfire_lit lands before their 'fire' code stops being drawn; reordered, two fires show.

title: A monster's wind-up look (the phone's copy of the worker's telegraph)
oneLine: The phone's copy of a monster's wind-up window, drawn as its element's swirl and a body throb.
topConcern: Shield Bash and parry cancel the worker's wind-up, but nothing clears the phone's _tgUntil; the warning plays on up to 1.2 s.

title: A swimmer drawn in the water: wading in, swimming or treading, climbing out
oneLine: A figure sinking into the water, swimming or treading, and climbing out, with hysteresis and teleport snaps for peers.
topConcern: A peer's swim is decided from this screen's drawn ground; where it is not laid yet, they are drawn standing in the water.

title: A jumper drawn in the air, and the touch-down squash
oneLine: A jumper lifted, stretched and leaned in the air, then squashed on landing; peers' spent jumps cleared here.
topConcern: A draw pass ends a peer's jump state, only for peers with a display; every reader checks the time, so harmless.

title: The skateboard under a rider: on, view, rolling, bump, off
oneLine: The skateboard sprite hung under a rider, its view, turning wheel spots, and bumps that borrow the jump's record.
topConcern: The bump sets _jumpY, so emoteFx thinks a rider is airborne: a cheer or flex flickers on each bump; tilting moves cancel bumps.

title: A figure's borrowed transform each frame: swim, jump, board, emote
oneLine: Swim, jump, board and emote passes each patch and restore the same figure transform every frame, in a fixed order.
topConcern: Order-dependent write-and-restore across four passes with cross-read marks; the board bump already breaks emotes, and reordering risks stuck tilts.

title: A trap drawn: the mark, then a spring's drop, shakes, snap or break
oneLine: The trap's mark ring and each spring's drop, shakes, snap or break, timed beside trapping.js's setTimeout beats.
topConcern: Mark and springs carry no zone and S._trap survives a zone change; a door taken within 15 s draws the ring in the dungeon.

title: Soot marks from a slime's blast: queued, live and fading, gone
oneLine: Ten pooled soot marks from slime blasts, live and fading for a minute, ended on leaving their zone.

title: The shared fx strips: loading at import, ready, or failed for good
oneLine: Global effect strips loading at import, ready or failed for good; every reader falls back while frames are empty.

title: The white-hot bow special: in flight, struck, smouldering, burnt out or flaring
oneLine: The bow special's white-hot look: flight, strike, a throb per chip tick, then burning out or flaring for a blast.
topConcern: LIFE_MS and TICK_MS are unpinned hand copies of projectiles.js's stuck-arrow timing, so the drawn throbs could drift.

title: The staff cast: charging, release, the bolt easing off the crystal, the crash and burst
oneLine: The staff crystal's charge, release flash, bolt easing off the crystal, and crash burst, edge-detected from cast stamps.

title: The Goo Grotto's moving bits: drips, bubbles, torch fires, spores, ferns
oneLine: The Goo Grotto's drips, bubbles, glints, torch fires and spores, each with explicit wait-grow-fall phases on timers.

title: Each land's trees and rocks wearing their element
oneLine: Per-resource element speck pools near the view, born and gone by alpha alone, with drips hanging then falling.

title: A building's life: smoke, lamps, sparks, glints, chaff, and the Town Hall's cut flag
oneLine: Chimney smoke, lamps, sparks, glints and chaff on Wheel buildings, and the Town Hall flag cut out of its page.
topConcern: Particles are born and killed by visible toggles and addChild in the big objects layer: the TRAPS §218 cost landAuras already fixed.

title: The sky by the hour: plain day, golden-hour tint, or a night light map
oneLine: Plain day, golden-hour tint or a rendered night light map, chosen each frame; held at midday on the Wheel.
topConcern: Night is dormant on the Wheel by the owner's call; it runs only on the farm and the retired old lands.

title: Dust prints, take-off and landing puffs, motes, and blood
oneLine: Dust prints and puffs per walker, take-off and landing puffs via an in-air set, motes, and blood bursts.
topConcern: _inAir empties only on a landing this pass sees; landing in dust-free land, dying mid-air or leaving mid-jump makes phantom landing puffs later.

title: The world's small motions: sway springs, chop kicks, breathing, ore glints
oneLine: Sway springs with chop kicks, NPC and monster breathing, and ore glint riders; the old town's building riders are retired.
topConcern: Building riders, prop sway and canopies run only for old-map props, and no prop exists on the Wheel.

title: The slice's code-drawn pictures: minted once on a canvas and kept
oneLine: Ten code-drawn effect pictures minted once on canvases and kept; only elemWindup and sootMarks are kept as images.
topConcern: Eight kept canvases skip keepAsImage (TRAPS §253); after Safari empties canvases or a rebuild, fires, blood, dust, auras and smoke can draw blank.
